recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern holiday aesthetic featuring a portrait of a male vocalist in the lower right foreground, set against a heavily blurred, warm-toned Christmas tree background with prominent bokeh circles. The typography is centered and stacked in the upper half, utilizing a bold, outlined sans-serif font.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground portrait anchored to the bottom right corner
Text block centered horizontally in the upper two-thirds
High contrast between sharp foreground subject and soft bokeh background
Warm, festive color palette dominated by golds, reds, and greens
coreInvariants: Heavy bokeh effect on the background lights
Black-outlined white typography for legibility against busy backgrounds
Subject wearing formal attire (suit and tie)
Square aspect ratio typical of CD/Vinyl covers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject in the bottom right quadrant, approximately 40% of the frame height, looking slightly off-camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face serves as the primary anchor, balanced by the heavy text block above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top text, moves down through the centered lines, and rests on the subject's face in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with either text, the subject, or dense bokeh patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm gold and amber bokeh lights providing the primary background texture.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black outlines on text and dark suit fabric provide necessary structural contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White text fill and highlights on the subject's face.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background lights with a medium-key value range; the subject is rendered with natural skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or cool-toned digital blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used throughout with varying scale.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century commercial feel.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the outline treatment.
Offers a cleaner, more modernistic take on the same era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1960s style color photograph of a man in a dark suit and tie in the bottom right corner. The background is a Christmas tree with very shallow depth of field, creating large, warm, glowing bokeh circles in gold, red, and green.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of centered, uppercase, bold sans-serif text in the top half of the image. The text must be white with a thick black outline.

verificationChecks: Is the text white with a black outline?
Is the background heavily blurred with bokeh?
Is the subject positioned in the lower right?
Is the overall mood warm and festive?

adjustableVariables: Specific holiday colors in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1960s film aesthetic (slight grain, warm cast)
Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify bokeh circles are large and soft
Confirm text is perfectly centered horizontally
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + Bokeh Background + Outlined Stacked Type = Retro Holiday Cover
